services.desc: Climb aboard Sand Dollar Cruises- the premiere private cruise company on the waters of the Rehoboth Bay! Plan your private cruise now for a memorable experience out on the water. Turn any special occasion into an unforgettable event. Celebrate a birthday, anniversary, bachelor and bachelorette party, or other special day on the Sand Dollar or Cycleboat. All private cruises are designed to accommodate your group. Bring any food or drinks you would like during your cruise. We will supply a marine-size cooler with ice and water, and handle all the cleanup and trash removal. You may also plug into our new sound system to play any music for your cruise. You will sail past stunning nature scenes,
